## Loading data

```{r}
#| echo: false
library('tidyverse')
library('Matrix')
```

```{r}

# Loading w/out Seurat

setwd("~/") # I've had to set it manually

count_matrix <- readMM('matrix.mtx.gz')
barcodes <- read.delim('barcodes.tsv.gz', header = FALSE)
features <- read.delim('features.tsv.gz', header = FALSE)
```

```{r}

features_id <- features |>
  select('V2')

t_fea <- t(features_id)
t_bar <- t(barcodes)

colnames(count_matrix) <- t_bar
rownames(count_matrix) <- t_fea
```

Features (at least x per cell/barcode) and counts for features (at least in x cells)

Columns (barcodes) with less than x features (empty beads) or more than x features (doublets)

Cells w/ more than x% of mitochondrial genes (damaged cells)

PC cutoff

Normalize, find variable, scale, PCA
